title: Sipling: Water Reminder
short: Track your water, get reminders, and grow a forest — one sip at a time.
full:
Sipling turns drinking water into something you can see.

Every glass waters a sapling. Hit your daily goal and it becomes a tree in your own forest. Miss a day? Nothing dies. Your sapling simply waits for you.

🌱 A FOREST THAT NEVER WITHERS
Most habit apps punish you. Sipling doesn't. There is no guilt, no dying plant, no broken heart icon. A day you missed is just a young sapling, still standing.

💧 A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
Your daily target is calculated from your weight, sex, age and activity level, based on the European Food Safety Authority's reference values for water from drinks. You can always adjust it yourself.

☕ NOT EVERYTHING COUNTS THE SAME
Tea, coffee, milk, juice and soda are counted with their own hydration factors — 250 ml of coffee is not 250 ml of water. Alcohol counts against you, honestly.

🔔 REMINDERS THAT ACTUALLY ARRIVE
Sipling reminds you between your waking hours, at the interval you choose, and goes quiet once you reach your goal. If your phone's battery settings are blocking notifications, there is a built-in guide that shows you exactly where to look — for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei and Oppo.

📱 HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Add a glass without opening the app. Your tree grows right there on your home screen.

❤️ HEALTH CONNECT (OPTIONAL)
Sipling can write what you drink to Android's shared health record. It only writes — it never reads anything. Off by default.

🔒 YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Sipling has no server and no account. It doesn't even have permission to access the internet. Everything you enter lives on your device and nowhere else. You can erase all of it in one tap.

🌳 EIGHT TREE SPECIES, TEN ACHIEVEMENTS
Oak, pine, sakura, maple, acacia, olive and more. Unlock them by keeping streaks and growing trees — never by paying for the basics.

✨ SIPLING PRO
Pro removes ads and unlocks seasonal forest themes and a few cosmetic trees. Tracking, goals, statistics, reminders and your forest are free, forever. We will never put a paywall in front of the things that matter.

— No interstitial ads between screens.
— No ads during celebrations.
— No account, no sign-up, no tracking.

Drink water. Grow a forest. Be kind to yourself.
